workspace.text:

- Tuesday: Priya & Marcus free 13:00-14:00 and 16:30-17:00; Elena & David free 09:00-10:00. No overlap.
- Wednesday: Priya & Marcus free 15:00-16:00; Elena & David free 13:00-14:00. No overlap.
- Thursday: Priya & Marcus free 10:00-10:30; Elena & David free 09:30-10:00 and 14:30-15:30. No overlap.
